name: Kemp Schuessler

items.why: The editorial is an opinion with no facts of its own, and the PAC texts it points to were sent by outside committees. The Bradenton Times news report shows no coordination by Schuessler, and declining an interview is a petty moment, not conduct bearing on big money.

for_review: I couldn't open the Manatee County campaign finance report on voterfocus.com (access denied), so I couldn't check the item's claim that developer or builder-sector donors gave him $1,000 each. Someone could check the donor list and the dollar amounts. The Bradenton Times news story says outside PACs (Christian Family Coalition Manatee PAC and Floridians for Public Safety PC) texted voters to support him. It doesn't say they coordinated with him. The one search on the owner's named sites (Alex Jones, Stew Peters, Ryan Dawson, Infowars) found nothing about Schuessler. No court, ethics or other official finding against him turned up. His Patch Q&A and the city bio list real work: 30 years in financial services, now an independent insurance agent, plus his own businesses.
